title: AW27 Women's Remastered Classics
summary: Familiar pieces made personal: blazers, skirts, marl jumpers and checks remixed with one colour that pops.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Boland's "Individual Familiarity" expects the blazer, skirt, trousers and suit to dominate through personal combinations; pure retro becomes nostalgia unless one hue pops <sup>[1]</sup>. Checks lead, from pinstripe to houndstooth <sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Mushroom, creamy white and tinted black with one accent: mustard or chartreuse <sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Blazer with a court skirt.
- Marl jumper over a shirt.
- Tapered trousers.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body: Flannel, glen check, herringbone, marl knit.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body: Contrast piping, horn and corozo buttons <sup>[1]</sup>.

design_implications: - Change linings, piping or colour rather than shape.
commercial_implications: - Core volume theme; buy deep in neutrals.
